# AI Tooling Digest - example run

This branch is the result of following [TRY_IT.md](../../TRY_IT.md) end to end: `/adapt` generated the two-agent team (researcher, editor), then the loop ran for three cycles. The digests are in [`digests/`](digests/), the no-repeat ledger in [`covered-items.md`](covered-items.md), and each agent turn's working notes in [`auto-outputs/ai-tooling-digest/docs/`](../../auto-outputs/ai-tooling-digest/docs/).

*The digests in this branch were generated by the agent team during a test run on 2026-11-19. They summarize public changelogs and release notes, may contain errors, and are not affiliated with or endorsed by the products mentioned. Follow the source links for authoritative details.*
